en.title: 4. Score Corrections & Edits
en.excerpt: Official procedures for editing arrow scores during active and submitted ends, judge authorization requirements, and audit logging.
en.content:
Correcting Values in Active Ends

While an end is still active on the mobile keypad, tap any incorrect arrow cell (for example, tapping an arrow box to change an 8 to a 9) to overwrite the value before tapping Save & Next End. Arrow totals and descending value sorting update automatically.

Editing Previously Submitted Ends

If a scoring discrepancy is identified after an end has already been submitted (such as during paper scorecard cross-verification):

  1. Tap the End Selector Tab at the top of the scoring screen to view past ends (e.g., End 2).
  2. Select the specific arrow box that requires adjustment.
  3. Enter the revised arrow value on the numeric keypad.
  4. Tap Submit Correction to apply the change.

Judge Authorization Protocols

In accordance with World Archery rules, arrow values cannot be modified once arrows have been pulled from the target without the direct permission of an official line judge. When an existing end is updated, the interface records whether verbal referee confirmation was obtained.

Immutable Server Audit Trails

Every score modification instantly recalculates cumulative point totals, 10s count, and Xs count across live public leaderboards. The system creates a permanent audit log entry recording the previous value, new value, timestamp, and scorekeeper session identifier to ensure full tournament integrity.
